description: This file is a localization module for the Select2 library, providing Macedonian translations for various interface messages.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Generates message indicating the user should input fewer characters.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Generates message indicating the user should input more characters.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Displays message while more results are loading.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Informs the user about the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Informs the user that no matching results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Displays a message indicating search is in progress.
